status: Derived experimental Pope/Durbin hybrid; not a published validated model
coefficient_selection: Previously documented 1990 constants; no coefficient search or empirical realizability multiplier
strain: Radial shear plus all continuity-compatible normal strains, identical to previous normal-production diagnostic; dV/dx omitted
constraint: Largest positive N <= Cmu K^2/E satisfying PSD(2K/3 identity - 2N S), with Fprime=-I F/(eta N) enforced simultaneously
time: T=N/(Cmu K); use in viscosity/diffusion, epsilon production C1 P/T, epsilon destruction (C2-C3 chi)E/T, and signed chi=T^3 trace(Omega^2 S)
edge_conditions: N=I delta/[(1-delta) m], Qk=-I K, Qe=-I E, m=1/sigma_k; final edge must be constrained
refinements: tol 1e-6 then 1e-8, 400 then 800 initial nodes; compare last edge pair, tolerances and meshes
source_gate: Half-width slope 0.125 for c3=0 or 0.086 for c3=0.79, within 2%; source consistency only, not proof of published hybrid provenance
limitations: Positive-semidefinite modeled covariance alone does not establish a finite-inertia stochastic dispersion model
No automatic conversion of RANS K to LES SGS energy

numerical_coordinate_amendment.coordinate: t=-log(1-z), exact chain rule; internal tolerance one decade tighter
numerical_coordinate_amendment.unchanged_gate: Recompute the original z-coordinate Lobatto residual and require <=1e-6; no model coefficients, edge powers, or physical thresholds changed

transition_matching_amendment.reason: 30273656 log-coordinate refinement also failed at sharp transition; use smooth inactive and active regions with unknown matching location
transition_matching_amendment.boundary_conditions: Six continuous state components and Ncap/Nnatural=1 at unknown transition; unchanged axis and edge conditions
transition_matching_amendment.refinements: Same tolerances and 400/800 initial-node comparison; original spatial residual gate retained
transition_matching_amendment.initializer: Use each accepted delta=0.000025, tol=1e-6 source-only state from 30273656; both meet original-coordinate residual gate. The former unconstrained initializer drove the control transition into a guarded boundary in 30273671; its failure is retained. No equation or coefficient changes.
transition_matching_amendment.initial_mesh: Grade the inner-domain mesh toward its steep near-edge endpoint; use the same 400/800 nominal counts. Uniform initial meshes rejected the control in 30273671 and 30273672; the corrected candidate qualified in both.
transition_matching_amendment.physical_residual_evaluation: Evaluate the unchanged original-z residual directly on native xi quadrature nodes in each affine region; affine Jacobians cancel in the interval-normalized RMS. Avoid subtracting nearly equal global z coordinates to invert the narrow outer map. Original 1e-6 gate retained.
transition_matching_amendment.final_initial_mesh: Uniform 400/800 restored after graded meshes failed strict refinement; native-coordinate residual evaluation alone did not resolve those failures.
transition_matching_amendment.deeper_edge_reason: Start further inside the active asymptotic edge region for both frozen cases. Control startup at delta=0.0001 failed; do not alter equations or numerical acceptance limits.
